summary: Going from AAP 2.4 to 2.6: upgrade AAP to 2.6 before the portal, read the 2.6 release notes for breaking changes, back up values with helm get values > backup-values.yaml, then verify OAuth sign-in (redirect URL must match the deployment URL) and update custom templates to the new syntax.
questions: Do I upgrade AAP or the portal first?
Portal sign-in fails after upgrading to AAP 2.6
